Webhook sync was replaced by CRM polling on branch daniel/hubspot-owner-sync; #405 is closed and #409 is open with auto-merge enabled. Commits 8b3e6f1, 2d90ac4, ae47c15 implement polling every 15 minutes, windowed paging past the 10k limit, and ARR > 0 only. Unit tests pass; the e2e failure still blocks #409.

- [prochaine-étape] Ask Noa to add HUBSPOT_TOKEN to AWS Secrets Manager for staging/prod.
- [essai-raté] Webhook subscription registration failed because private app tokens cannot manage webhook subscriptions by API.
- [décision] Use polling every 15 minutes and close #405 (source: t04).
- [décision] Sync only companies with ARR > 0, skipping trials (source: t10).
- [décision] Open the PR with auto-merge and move the token to Secrets Manager (source: t12).
